valid.name: direct member access off this - allowed
direct method call off this in object method - allowed
static context: new this() - subclass-aware construction, this is the constructor
valid.code: class Foo { static create() { return new this(); } }

valid.name: static context: Reflect.construct(this, []) - reflective form of the same idiom
valid.code: class Foo { static create() { const made = Reflect.construct(this, []); return made; } }

valid.name: static context: this as a guard argument - Foo.isConstructed(result, this)
valid.code: class Foo { static isConstructed(a, b) { return a === b; } static create() { return Foo.isConstructed(null, this); } }

valid.name: static block: this is the constructor
valid.code: class Foo { static registry = null; static { Foo.registry = new WeakSet(); } }

invalid.name: const self = this - aliases the receiver to a local binding
invalid.code: class Foo { bar() { const self = this; } }

invalid.name: x = this - aliases the receiver by assignment
invalid.code: class Foo { bar() { let x; x = this; } }

invalid.name: capture(this) from an INSTANCE method - hands the whole receiver to another function
invalid.code: function capture(x) {} class Foo { bar() { capture(this); } }

invalid.name: foo.bind(this) - receiver escapes via a member call argument
const arr = [this] - receiver escapes as an array element
const o = { self: this } - receiver escapes as an object property value
invalid.code: class Foo { bar() { const o = { self: this }; } }

invalid.name: class-field self = this - receiver stored on a PropertyDefinition value
invalid.code: class Foo { bar() { this.x = 1; } baz = this; }

invalid.name: Object.assign(this, fields) - bulk external mutation of the receiver
instance method hands itself to a static helper
invalid.code: class Foo { static serialize(x) { return x; } toJSON() { return Foo.serialize(this); } }

invalid.name: const { alpha } = this - destructuring detaches state from the receiver
invalid.code: class Foo { alpha = 1; bar() { const { alpha } = this; return alpha; } }

invalid.name: this.parent = this - stores a self-cycle on the instance
invalid.code: class Foo { parent = null; bar() { this.parent = this; } }
